info.title: OnSkillIT staff inquiry operations API
info.description: PHASE-05 staff-only redaction of one public inquiry (ADR 0011). Listing is a server-rendered staff page at /staff/crm/leads, not a JSON endpoint. Requires a staff session, the inquiries.redact permission and a matching CSRF token.

post.summary: Permanently redact the personal fields of one inquiry

200.description: Name, email, phone and message were removed; an audit event was appended.

400.description: Invalid body, or equal or malformed references.

403.description: Wrong origin, missing CSRF token, or no inquiries.redact permission.
